title: Failed pickup: seller closed, item not ready, or under-declared
keywords: failed pickup seller closed parcel not ready under-declared cancel reason 50% fee waiting
body: Seller closed: agent calls the seller and CS, keeps the call log and a photo, then cancels with reason 'Arrived but seller closed' with the photo and call log as POD.
Items can't be located: cancel with reason 'Parcel not ready' with proof photo and call log.
Under-declared: agent contacts CS, cancels with reason 'Parcel under-declared' with a photo of the item.
A 50% cancellation fee applies when the agent arrived and the item was not ready / wrong address / under-declared. Cancel with the correct status; the customer must acknowledge the fee first.
TikTok failed pickup (seller's fault) = 50% fee: waiting over 15 mins, item not packed (10-min allowance), shop closed, wrong waybill, nobody present.
